components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single most important action on a surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-foreground); padding: 1rem 2rem; border: 0; border-radius: 0; font: 600 0.75rem/1rem var(--font-sans); letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--color-primary); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A secondary action that keeps the stage quiet.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: transparent; color: var(--color-muted); padding: 1rem 2rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 0; font: 600 0.75rem/1rem var(--font-sans); letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary) 50%, transparent); color: var(--color-accent); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--color-primary); }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: The standard sharp-edged field for typed content.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: grid; gap: 0.25rem; color: var(--color-muted); font: 500 0.8125rem/1.25rem var(--font-sans); } .ds-input { width: 100%; background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-foreground); padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 0; font: 400 1rem/1.4 var(--font-mono); outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-muted) 30%, transparent); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--color-primary); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--color-primary); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: A sticky account or session header with a restrained live surface.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 3.5rem; padding: 0 1.5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-background) 80%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); } .ds-wordmark { color: var(--color-foreground); font: 900 1rem/1 var(--font-sans); letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-nav-action { padding: 0.75rem 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--color-muted); font: 600 0.75rem/1rem var(--font-sans); letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-action:hover { color: var(--color-foreground); } .ds-nav-action:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--color-primary); }

components.name: Resource Row
components.description: A full-row resource link with a separate destructive action.
components.html: Spring assessment12 questions
components.css: .ds-resource-row { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; padding: 1rem 1.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-surface); } .ds-resource-link { display: grid; gap: 0.25rem; color: var(--color-foreground); text-decoration: none; } .ds-resource-link span { color: var(--color-muted); font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-resource-row:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary) 40%, var(--color-border)); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-surface) 80%, transparent); } .ds-delete { position: relative; padding: 0.75rem 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--color-muted); font: 600 0.75rem/1rem var(--font-sans); letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-delete:hover, .ds-delete:focus-visible { color: var(--color-danger); } .ds-delete:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--color-danger); }

components.name: Answer Option
components.description: A letter-coded response control with a protected option identity.
components.css: .ds-option { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; width: 100%; padding: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 0; background: var(--color-background); color: var(--color-foreground); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-option-a:hover, .ds-option-a:focus-visible { border-color: #2563eb; background: color-mix(in srgb, #2563eb 14%, var(--color-background)); } .ds-option:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--color-primary); } .ds-option-marker { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 1.5rem; height: 1.5rem; border: 1px solid #2563eb; color: #2563eb; font: 700 0.6875rem/1 var(--font-sans); letter-spacing: 0.1em; }

components.name: Leaderboard Row
components.description: A ranked result row with stable live numerals.
components.css: .ds-leaderboard-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 0; background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-foreground); } .ds-rank { width: 1.5rem; color: var(--color-muted); font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-leaderboard-row strong { color: var(--color-success); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Live Participant Count
components.description: An accent count that makes live audience scale immediately legible.
components.css: .ds-live-count { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.5rem; color: var(--color-accent); } .ds-live-count strong { font: 900 1.5rem/1 var(--font-sans); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-live-count span { color: var(--color-muted); font: 600 0.75rem/1rem var(--font-sans); letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; }

narrative.overview:
Hermes is a live broadcast staged in a near-black room. The surround stays flat and quiet so the question, timer, answer state, or leaderboard delta can take the spotlight. The atmosphere is theatrical and precise at once: terminal clarity carrying broadcaster stakes. Colour is scarce by design, so an active state reads immediately under time pressure.

The implementation is a dark, sharp-edged system built from semantic CSS tokens and a small set of shared utility patterns. The terminal influence appears in uppercase tracked labels, hairline rules, monospace typed content, and deliberate status feedback, not in CRT effects or retro decoration. Surfaces are mostly flat tonal layers, with localized depth where an open dropdown or drawer needs separation.
keyCharacteristics: Flat near-black canvas and charcoal surfaces with a compact neutral range.
Sharp rectangular controls and 1px borders as the default geometry.
Geist Sans for interface text and live numerals; Geist Mono for typed identifiers and scoring fields.
Broadcast blue for action, sky blue for liveness, and a protected A/B/C/D option palette.
Motion is state communication: fade for content appearing in place, rise for surfaces that genuinely arrive, spring for response bars.

rules.name: The Spotlight Rule
rules.body: Let one saturated color act at a time. Keep surrounding controls neutral or muted so the active state wins without visual noise.

rules.name: The Option Palette Is Sacred
rules.body: A/B/C/D colors mean answer choice. Do not reuse them for chrome, navigation, generic icons, or unrelated status.

rules.name: The Tabular Digit Rule
rules.body: Timers, scores, ranks, counts, and response totals use tabular-nums so live updates do not move the surrounding layout.

rules.name: The Mono Stays in the Field Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono belongs in inputs, identifiers, codes, and scoring fields. It does not belong in headings, display numerals, or general labels.

rules.name: The Movement Must Tell the Truth Rule
rules.body: Use fade when cached or existing content appears in place. Reserve travel for something that genuinely arrived, such as a drawer, dropdown, or next question.

dos: Do keep page backgrounds in the Midnight Stage family and use semantic tokens instead of raw component colors.
Do reserve A/B/C/D colors for answer options.
Do use hairline rule borders as the default structural device.
Do apply tabular-nums to values that update live.
Do use Geist Mono only for typed identifiers, form content, and scoring inputs.
Do keep loading twins geometrically coupled to their rendered components.
Do use motion to explain arrival, change, locking, or reveal, and honor reduced-motion preferences.
donts: Don't introduce light surfaces, rounded SaaS cards, confetti, CRT scanlines, fake noise, or gradient text.
Don't reuse the answer palette for navigation, chrome, or unrelated status.
Don't use shadows as the default card treatment; reserve them for localized overlay separation like the dropdown and scoring drawer.
Don't use Geist Mono for display numerals or headings.
Don't animate decoration that does not communicate a state change.
Don't hand-copy skeleton geometry when the source component can expose its layout shell.
